patterns.note: A dark-themed layout with full-width sections, featuring a prominent split-layout hero (text on left, complex data visualization on right) and subsequent centered text blocks for value propositions.
High-contrast typography uses large, bold sans-serif headings for impact, paired with lighter-weight body text and very small, uppercase labels for navigation and dashboard elements.

A limited, high-contrast color palette of deep charcoal/black backgrounds and light grey/white text, punctuated by vibrant orange for CTAs and a mix of green and orange for data visualization accents.

Content sections are revealed with a scroll-triggered animation, where elements slide up and subtly fade into view from the bottom as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic progression down the page.
The hero section prominently features a detailed, interactive-looking data dashboard as a primary visual element, immediately conveying a data-driven and technical product.

technique_notes: A dark mode aesthetic is consistently applied across the site, utilizing deep charcoal backgrounds and light text for high contrast and a modern, technical feel.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements slide up and subtly fade in as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience. This is likely achieved with CSS keyframes for controlled transitions.
The primary navigation bar at the top and a persistent cookie consent banner at the bottom remain fixed in the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to key actions and information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very small, uppercase labels for navigation and data points.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., buttons, dashboard cards, content blocks) provide a soft, modern feel without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing in hero and centered text sections, and more compact arrangements within the dashboard and footer link areas.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the prominent, interactive-looking data dashboard integrated directly into the hero section. This immediately communicates a sophisticated, data-driven product and sets a highly technical, authoritative tone, moving beyond typical hero imagery.
